messages.subject: Can gl2genepop specify 3-digit format?
parts:
Hi all,

Is there a valid solution to using gl2genepop but with specification that the three-digit output format is required, where a[j] <- "000000" instead of a[j] <- "0000"? This is for use as input into resdismapper which only accepts the three-digit format.

Many thanks,
Caroline.

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Can gl2genepop specify 3-digit format?
parts:
Hi Caroline,

I have added a parameter to gl2genepop to choose from a 2 digits format or a 3 digits format as output.
Also, populations can now be ordered using a vector, see example below.
To use this updated version of the function, you should install the beta version of dartR as follows:

> devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR@beta")

# example
> test <- gl.filter.callrate(platypus.gl,threshold = 1)
> popNames(test)
> gl2genepop(test, pop_order = c("TENTERFIELD","SEVERN_ABOVE","SEVERN_BELOW"),output_format="3_digits")

Cheers,
Luis
